admission.justification: Spans host agents and the AR server: one bound server per created agent plus narrow Claude-only server_info preapproval, with D124's assignment_read removal, bounds the multi-agent surface FAM-N17BB4 launches into.

applicability: Every host agent created for a role launch.
conditions: The agent binding names this launch's AR server.
Preapproval is the Claude-only server_info identity read.
exclusions: The removed assignment_read grant and any alternative task reader.
Broad tool grants, which no launch carries.
statement: Each created host agent receives its own bound AR server; Claude-only preapproval is narrow server_info identity access. D124 removes assignment_read and its former grant instead of keeping an alternative task reader.
